plan.title: School Performance & Infrastructure
plan.subtitle: Enrollment trends, gender gaps, and facility status by block

panels.title: Total Enrolled (2024)
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Girls 2024") + SUM("Boys 2024") AS n FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"

panels.title: Schools with Girls Toilets
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "school_infrastructure" WHERE "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'Yes'

panels.title: Schools with Electricity
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "school_infrastructure" WHERE "Electricity" = 'Yes'

panels.title: Enrollment Trend by Year
panels.sql: SELECT '2022' AS year, SUM("Girls 2022") + SUM("Boys 2022") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" UNION ALL SELECT '2023' AS year, SUM("Girls 2023") + SUM("Boys 2023") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" UNION ALL SELECT '2024' AS year, SUM("Girls 2024") + SUM("Boys 2024") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"

panels.title: Girls vs Boys Enrollment (2024)
panels.sql: SELECT 'Girls' AS gender, SUM("Girls 2024") AS count FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" UNION ALL SELECT 'Boys' AS gender, SUM("Boys 2024") AS count FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"

panels.title: Infrastructure Gaps by Block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS total_schools, SUM(CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_toilets, SUM(CASE WHEN "Electricity" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_electricity FROM "school_infrastructure" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 5 Schools by 2024 Enrollment
panels.sql: SELECT "School Name", "Girls 2024", "Boys 2024", ("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") AS total_2024 FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" ORDER BY total_2024 DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The dashboard tracks {{p1}} schools across the region. Total enrollment reached {{p2}} in 2024, showing a trend captured in the bar chart. Infrastructure gaps remain a concern, with {{p3}} schools having functional toilets for girls and {{p4}} having electricity. The block-level analysis highlights specific areas needing intervention for basic facilities.
